_provenance.source: Bybit public v5 kline, category=linear, interval=D, limit=365, pulled via the trainer-vm-diag relay (issue #9966)
_provenance.basis: Pearson r on DAILY LOG RETURNS of aligned closes
_provenance.coverage_note: CRYPTO ONLY. The open book also holds GLD, IEF, IWM, MES, MGC, QLD, QQQ, SCHA, SLV, SPY, TLT, USO -- every pair involving one of those is UNMEASURED, which is NOT the same as uncorrelated. scripts/ops/portfolio_conflict_audit.py reports those pairs explicitly rather than folding them into 'no conflict'. Extending coverage needs an equity/ETF price source, which is the same corpus gap that blocks sweeping the mgc/qqq/tlt/spy exit legs.
_provenance.staleness_note: Correlation is NOT stationary -- the 90d and 365d windows differ by up to 0.14 (ADAUSDT~ETHUSDT: 0.72 vs 0.84). Re-measure before leaning on this; a stale matrix is a confident wrong answer.
